original_question: Convene an actual panel (not a report) on git diff drafting-tools..record-votes -- the vote-recording system for the Newspeak House Governance Laboratory's Constitutional Record -- staffed from six named perspectives (constitutional/institutional design, adversarial security, interface and attention, small-group governance in practice, software reliability, the disengaged member's advocate), producing rounds of real disagreement and a tensions register rather than a smoothed consensus, against the hard 2/23/30 November 2026 deadlines.
clarified_scope: Mid-session, reweighted by the coordinator: the rendered dashboard (docs/index.html) is the primary subject -- layout, hierarchy, what a tired member on a phone perceives and does. Wider UX (Discord link to recorded position, the issue forms as forms, CONTRIBUTING.md under time pressure) is substantial but secondary. Constitutional, security and reliability lenses retained but subordinated to member experience -- they speak only when a finding changes what a member is shown or asked to do. The disengaged member's advocate (B.J. Fogg) and interface/attention (Don Norman) became the lead voices; output shape shifted from an even tensions register toward five concrete UI findings with fixes, plus a trimmed register of the tensions that survived being pointed at experience.

options: hold all UI work until the §3.2 election is settled
split: ship R1 and R3 only, defer R2/R4/R5
